body: Language models are increasingly expected to support users in stressful or uncertain situations, where warmth and empathy are desirable. While recent work associates warmer models with reduced reliability, we show that this conclusion is incomplete. Prior studies often train primarily on empathetic dialogue, making it difficult to separate tone effects from SFT-induced distribution shift. We revisit this issue at both the model and evaluation levels. We study prompting, SFT, and RL for inducing warm behavior, and comprehensively evaluate capability preservation using an 11-dataset benchmark suite and EMOFACT under emotional contexts. Across multiple model families, we find that warmth effects are task- and model-dependent, while task-aligned adaptive tone can improve empathy and targeted reliability, although some capability trade-offs remain. We further introduce human-validated empathy evaluators specifically developed to assess empathetic model responses. Our results suggest that models can be more supportive in social interactions while remaining reliable.
summaryZh: 本文探讨了大模型在情感交互中表现出的“共情”与“可靠性”之间的关系。研究指出，以往认为共情能力会导致可靠性下降的结论存在偏差，这往往是由于监督微调（SFT）带来的分布偏移所致。通过在多个模型家族和11个数据集上的评估，研究发现共情效果具有任务和模型依赖性，且通过任务对齐的自适应语调可以在保持可靠性的同时提升共情表现。此外，作者引入了人类验证的共情评估器，为开发更具支持性且可靠的交互模型提供了新思路。

glossary.explanationZh: 监督微调，通过标注数据对预训练模型进行特定任务的参数优化。
分布偏移，指训练数据与推理数据在统计分布上的不一致。
强化学习，通过奖励机制引导模型生成符合预期的行为。
能力保持，指在进行特定优化（如共情训练）时，模型原有核心能力的稳定性。
